svg.title: Teacher journey
svg.desc: A teacher moves from sources to an evidence packet, a sourced draft, checks and lint, MySTRA inspection, explicit rule-003 human approval, and class delivery. A separate loop reviews learner contributions in the teacher dashboard before approved community bundles can return to class.

text.font-family: Georgia, 'Iowan Old Style', 'Palatino Linotype', 'Book Antiqua', serif

svg.text: Evidence, review, and an explicit human decision before class
Packet / draft → browser approval → synthesis is not one continuous integrated handoff.
Reject or request revision → no publication
